description_en: Queries the list of software prohibition policies under the current Alibaba Cloud account by paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的软件禁用策略列表
name: ListProhibitedPolicies

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The collection of software prohibition policy IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 软件禁用策略ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: policy_ids

parameters.help_en:
The prohibited software tag ID, used to filter policies that reference this tag. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedTags](~~ListProhibitedTags~~): Lists prohibited software tags.
[CreateProhibitedTag](~~CreateProhibitedTag~~): Creates a custom prohibited software tag
parameters.help_zh:
禁用软件标签ID，用于筛选引用该标签的策略。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedTags](~~ListProhibitedTags~~)：批量查询禁用软件标签。
[CreateProhibitedTag](~~CreateProhibitedTag~~)：创建自定义禁用软件标签
parameters.name: tag_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the prohibited software is a system built-in entry. Valid values:
true: A system built-in prohibited software entry shared by all Alibaba Cloud accounts. Modification and deletion are not supported.
false: Custom prohibited software under the current Alibaba Cloud account
fields.help_zh:
是否为系统内置禁用软件。取值：
true：系统内置禁用软件，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义禁用软件
fields.name: is_default

fields.help_en:
The prohibited software ID. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~): Lists prohibited software.
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~): Creates custom prohibited software
fields.help_zh:
禁用软件ID。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~)：批量查询禁用软件。
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~)：创建自定义禁用软件
fields.name: software_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the prohibited software
parameters.name: software_id

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID, used to filter policies whose effective scope includes this user group. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): Lists user groups.
[CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~): Creates a user group
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的策略。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组。
[CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~)：创建用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en: Policy Name of the software prohibition policy. Fuzzy match is supported. Policy Name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 软件禁用策略名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The action to take. Valid values:
Ban: Blocks the software from running and displays a pop-up notification on the endpoint to alert the user.
BanSilent: Blocks the software from running without notifying the user. The blocking is silent.
Warn: Only displays a pop-up notification on the endpoint to alert the user without blocking the software from running
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作。取值：
Ban：禁止运行并在终端弹窗提醒终端用户。
BanSilent：禁止运行且不提醒终端用户，静默阻断。
Warn：仅在终端弹窗提醒终端用户，不阻断软件运行
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled. The policy is delivered to endpoints and takes effect.
false: Disabled. The policy configuration is retained but not delivered to endpoints
parameters.help_zh:
策略是否启用。取值：
true：启用，策略会下发到终端并生效。
false：停用，策略保留配置但不下发到终端
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en:
The object type of the controlled target. Valid values:
App: Controls by prohibited software. The controlled objects are specified by SoftwareIds.
Tag: Controls by prohibited software tag. The controlled objects are specified by TagIds. All prohibited software under the tag is controlled
parameters.help_zh:
管控对象类型。取值：
App：按禁用软件管控，管控对象由SoftwareIds指定。
Tag：按禁用软件标签管控，管控对象由TagIds指定，标签内的全部禁用软件均被管控
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account. No user group needs to be specified.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in the user groups specified by UserGroupIds
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效，不需要指定用户组。
UserGroupNormal：仅对UserGroupIds指定的用户组内的用户生效
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The name of the prohibited software. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: software_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the prohibited software tag. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 禁用软件标签名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: tag_name

Policies.description_en: The list of software prohibition policies, sorted by priority from highest to lowest
Policies.description_zh: 软件禁用策略列表，按优先级从高到低排列

AllowReport.description_en:
Indicates whether endpoint users are allowed to submit a filing request for this policy. Valid values:
true: Filing is allowed. The endpoint pop-up notification provides a filing entry.
false: Filing is not allowed
AllowReport.description_zh:
是否允许终端用户对该策略发起报备申请。取值：
true：允许报备，终端弹窗提供报备入口。
false：不允许报备

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the software prohibition policy, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, using the UTC+8 time zone
CreateTime.description_zh: 软件禁用策略的创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用UTC+8时区

Description.description_en: The description of the software prohibition policy

Enabled.description_en:
Specifies whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled. The policy is delivered to endpoints and takes effect.
false: Disabled. The policy configuration is retained but not delivered to endpoints
Enabled.description_zh:
策略是否启用。取值：
true：启用，策略会下发到终端并生效。
false：停用，策略保留配置但不下发到终端

ForceKill.description_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly terminate running software processes. Valid values:
true: The endpoint immediately terminates the running processes of the software when the policy is matched.
false: Running processes are not terminated. Only subsequent launches are blocked
ForceKill.description_zh:
是否强制结束已运行的软件进程。取值：
true：终端在命中策略时立即结束该软件正在运行的进程。
false：不结束已运行的进程，仅阻止后续启动

MainButtonTextCh.description_en: The Chinese text of the primary button in the endpoint pop-up notification
MainButtonTextCh.description_zh: 终端弹窗主按钮的中文文案

MainButtonTextEn.description_en: The English text of the primary button in the endpoint pop-up notification
MainButtonTextEn.description_zh: 终端弹窗主按钮的英文文案

MatchMode.description_en:
The policy matching target type. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Associated with all users.
UserGroupNormal: Associated with specific user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组

MinorButtonTextCh.description_en: The Chinese text of the secondary button in the endpoint pop-up notification
MinorButtonTextCh.description_zh: 终端弹窗次按钮的中文文案

MinorButtonTextEn.description_en: The English text of the secondary button in the endpoint pop-up notification
MinorButtonTextEn.description_zh: 终端弹窗次按钮的英文文案

Name.description_en: The name of the software prohibition policy

ObjectType.description_en:
The object type of the controlled target. Valid values:
App: Controls by prohibited software. The controlled objects are specified by SoftwareIds.
Tag: Controls by prohibited software tag. The controlled objects are specified by TagIds. All prohibited software under the tag is controlled
ObjectType.description_zh:
管控对象类型。取值：
App：按禁用软件管控，管控对象由SoftwareIds指定。
Tag：按禁用软件标签管控，管控对象由TagIds指定，标签内的全部禁用软件均被管控

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the software prohibition policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The action to take. Valid values:
Ban: Blocks the software from running and displays a pop-up notification on the endpoint to alert the user.
BanSilent: Blocks the software from running without notifying the user. The blocking is silent.
Warn: Only displays a pop-up notification on the endpoint to alert the user without blocking the software from running
PolicyType.description_zh:
处置动作。取值：
Ban：禁止运行并在终端弹窗提醒终端用户。
BanSilent：禁止运行且不提醒终端用户，静默阻断。
Warn：仅在终端弹窗提醒终端用户，不阻断软件运行

Priority.description_en: The policy priority. Valid values: 0 to 99. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 策略优先级。取值范围：0~99，数值越小优先级越高

PromptCh.description_en: The Chinese prompt content displayed in the endpoint pop-up notification
PromptCh.description_zh: 终端弹窗的中文提示内容
PromptCh.example: 该软件已被企业安全策略禁止运行，如需使用请提交报备申请。

PromptEn.description_en: The English prompt content displayed in the endpoint pop-up notification
PromptEn.description_zh: 终端弹窗的英文提示内容
PromptEn.example: This software is blocked by your enterprise security policy.

SoftwareIds.description_en: The collection of prohibited software directly controlled by this policy
SoftwareIds.description_zh: 该策略直接管控的禁用软件集合

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the prohibited software is a system built-in entry. Valid values:
true: A system built-in prohibited software entry shared by all Alibaba Cloud accounts. Modification and deletion are not supported.
false: Custom prohibited software under the current Alibaba Cloud account
IsDefault.description_zh:
该禁用软件是否为系统内置禁用软件。取值：
true：系统内置禁用软件，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义禁用软件

TagIds.description_en: The collection of prohibited software tag IDs controlled by this policy
TagIds.description_zh: 该策略管控的禁用软件标签ID集合

TitleCh.description_en: The Chinese title of the endpoint pop-up notification

TitleEn.description_en: The English title of the endpoint pop-up notification

UserGroupIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs to which this policy applies
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 该策略生效的用户组ID集合

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of software prohibition policies
